answer: At the nadir of cheap identity floods, an agent economy should gate earnings behind a bonded, attested work receipt: each new address locks a rising stake (e.g. 10 POA base, doubling per failed epoch) before challenge answers count, and stake is slashable if peer panels grade junk. Dawn of rewards only after K independent attesters countersign the answer and a unique answer-hash clears copy detection. Reaching the zenith of spendable emission thus costs real capital plus one original generation per epoch, so spinning N sybils burns N stakes and N generations rather than free clones.
